description:
Version 2.8.0 adds a dependency audit and correction supplement for Dense Algebraic Loci of Hodge Classes. It contains a repaired written proof of F2 implies the Hodge conjecture for abelian varieties, assuming F2; a precise explanation of the F3-prime correspondence obligation; exact rational-matrix and independent character checks reproducing eight Mumford invariants, six divisor-product directions and two exceptional directions; and three checked auxiliary Lean subspace lemmas with their logs and pinned Lean/Mathlib setup.

The audit distinguishes the independent reduction from deductions conditional on three withdrawn preprints, corrects the direction of a sixfold invariant-dimension bound, and identifies remaining cycle-construction and propagation obligations. The previous v2.7.0 paper and its code are retained for context; this release does not recertify every claim in that manuscript.

F2, F3-prime and the full rational Hodge conjecture remain unproved. No algebraic representatives for the two exceptional Mumford directions have been constructed. The Lean lemmas do not formalise the geometric conjecture. Authorship remains Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya. The supplement records AI assistance and requires author review.
